text:
Maya (CS): Starting Glyphon onboarding thread. Need to align owners, success criteria, timeline, and any procurement/renewal risks. Can folks do a 25m sync tomorrow?

Ethan (Solutions): I can. Tech note: Glyphon prefers tokenized logs and EU data residency for pilot. They'll need a short-lived staging API key and a CIDR for peering.

Rina (PM): Proposed minimal success criteria: 1) authenticated test call within 48h, 2) pilot cohort of 4 users with the test-suite pass-rate >=80%, 3) baseline cost estimate agreed. Renewal risk: finance needs a signed PO by day 28 or approval stalls.

Cal (Customer Eng): Enablement plan: 1x 45m live quickstart (API, prompts, observability) + 1x 30m ops review. I'll prepare a demo notebook and a one-page runbook. Recommend recording quickstart and a 3-question feedback survey after.

Asha Iyer (Glyphon): Hi all. We'll provide SAML metadata and peering CIDR by Tue EOD. Procurement contact is Ben (cc). Can you confirm default retention and masking options?

Maya (CS): Default pilot retention 30 days. We support pseudonymization and token masking. I'll post the doc.

Ethan (Solutions): Firewall example we'll ask them to provision: ```allow tcp 443 to 198.51.100.0/24``` Also request their staging cert for TLS testing.

Rina (PM): Draft timeline: Week0: auth & infra; Week1: pilot integration + smoke tests; Week2: evaluation & ops handoff; Week3: scale discussion & commercial check. If procurement not started by day 10 we'll escalate.

Onboard Bot: Created workspace "glyphon-pilot" in Console  https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/glyphon-pilot. Access granted to Maya, Ethan, Rina, Cal.

Ben Torres (Glyphon): Confirmed. SAML metadata and CIDR will be with you Tue EOD. We'll aim to review SOW by day 7.

Cal (Customer Eng): Eval harness: I'll select 12 prompts across main flows; pass criteria mean utility >=0.75 and no safety-critical failures. I'll upload harness to workspace before the quickstart.

Maya (CS): Action items: Ethan  share firewall/peering template; Cal  upload eval harness + runbook draft; Rina  post SOW draft and tracker; Maya  schedule kickoff and share retention doc. Glyphon: please share SAML + cert by Tue EOD.

Rina (PM): Procurement mitigation: propose a conditional milestone at day 14 to lock pilot pricing in the SOW. I'll add that clause.

Maya (CS): Ok locking sync for Wed 11am PT. I'll send invites with workspace links. If blockers appear before Tue EOD flag here. Thanks everyone.
